entries.title: Fixed Balloon Wire Loops and Tapered Grip Whisk
entries.description: One newly authored complete empty balloon-whisk exterior. Six whole slender returned wire loops surround a deep balloon-shaped open head in distinct meridional planes, with staggered distal returns rather than six exactly coincident tip intersections. Every whole loop has both ends rooted into one full axial ferrule. A complete long tapered turned-profile grip continues from that ferrule. A single whole rigid resting pose puts a wire head low point and the rear grip low point on the same ground datum without bending the handle or editing component proportions. All numerical geometry newly authored: no thin-scaled pastry-blender ribbons, cropped grilling-basket lattice or imported brush. Unlike five parallel broad U ribbons with a crosswise palm grip, this is a radial open balloon of returned wires and a long axial ferrule/grip. Three constant opaque PBR roles, metres Z up and whole bounds-centred ground origin. One original model zero scenes; repeated loops do not count separately. Static kitchen game art only: no food, whipping/mixing performance, wire flex, hand fit, food-contact suitability, hygiene, balance, manufacture or safety capability. Rigging animation and interaction not made.
